clue.text: Written evidence of unsurpassed performance

definitions.meaning: a written account kept as proof of what happened
the best performance ever achieved, as in a world best

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share one word: a documented account and a best-ever achievement in sport or elsewhere.

clue.text: Prepared to fight again on getting back to sea

parts.note: rear means back
Med is short for the Mediterranean Sea

explanation.surface: A navy gets ready for battle once more on returning to the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Equipped once more with weapons describes a force readied for combat again.

clue.text: Spell "trinket"

definitions.meaning: a magical incantation
a small ornament worn on a bracelet

explanation.definitionFit: Both a magic incantation and a small ornament on a bracelet share the one word.

clue.text: Editing revolutionary operation

parts.note: red is a byword for a communist revolutionary
action means operation, as in a military action

explanation.surface: Editing is described as a radical procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: Preparing text for publication, often by removing material, is a form of editorial work.

clue.text: Book place where game may be held

definitions.meaning: to book is to set aside a seat or table in advance

definitions.text: place where game may be held
definitions.meaning: an area of protected land where wild animals hunted as game are kept

explanation.definitionFit: Booking ahead is the verb sense; a game park or nature sanctuary is the noun sense.

clue.text: Relief to put on clothes again

definitions.meaning: remedy or compensation for a wrong
..., to dress once more

explanation.definitionFit: Legal remedy for a grievance is one sense; split as re-dress it means clothing oneself anew.

clue.text: Clasp part of trombone

definitions.meaning: a hair clip, called a hair ... in Britain
the movable tube a trombonist pushes in and out

explanation.definitionFit: A hair clip in British usage and the sliding tube of the brass instrument share the word.

clue.text: Stream let out, rising again

indicators.note: rent is spread outside the stream, so out marks it as the outer piece

parts.note: to let a property is to rent it
a surge is a rush or stream of water

explanation.surface: A river is released and floods upward once more.
explanation.definitionFit: Reviving or coming back strongly after a decline describes something gaining strength anew.

clue.text: Makes corrections to send me changes

indicators.note: changes signals that the letters of send me are altered in order

explanation.surface: An editor asks for a document so they can make alterations.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend a text is to remove errors from it, the same verb as correcting it.

clue.text: Smart game grasped by agent

indicators.note: being grasped means held inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
snap is a card game

explanation.surface: A stylish match is gripped by an operative.
explanation.definitionFit: A snappy dresser is stylish, so the word means neat and fashionable as smart does.

clue.text: Given up as hopelessly wicked

definitions.meaning: deserted or left behind for good
shamelessly immoral, beyond redemption

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both deserted and utterly depraved, as in an abandoned wretch.

clue.text: One's girl-child, perhaps

parts.note: one is, contracted, gives I + S
Sue is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A parent's daughter is presumably their girl-child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's' is read as 'one is', giving I (one) and S (is shortened), then SUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Offspring are a person's descendants in legal language, and a child is one example of them.

clue.text: Tragic girl caught by ape

parts.note: Mimi is the doomed heroine of Puccini's opera La Bohème
C is the cricket scoring abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An opera heroine seized by a large primate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just joins the pieces: MIMI sits beside C.
explanation.definitionFit: To ape someone is to copy their manner, a verb synonym for imitating.

clue.text: Had rather have been promoted

definitions.meaning: liked better, chose in favour of
preferment is promotion, so to be raised in rank is to be advanced in this sense

explanation.definitionFit: Favoured over others is one sense; an old sense of the verb is to advance in office.

clue.text: Fate seems insignificant to boy

parts.note: Des is a short form of the boy's name Desmond
tiny means very small, of no account

explanation.surface: Destiny looks a trivial matter to a young lad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seems' and 'to' only link the pieces; the boy's name is a short form of Desmond, common in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name the predetermined course of events that a life is held to follow.

clue.text: Gloomy but sensible about Act 1

indicators.note: about means around, so sensible goes round the other pieces

parts.note: sane means sensible
a turn is a stage act
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A theatregoer is dour yet level-headed about the opening act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the sensible word round the stage act and the Roman one; 'but' is a link. A turn is a music-hall performer's act.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone of a morose, sullen temperament, said in astrology to be born under Saturn, is gloomy.

clue.text: One poses to rest it afresh

indicators.note: doing something afresh means making it anew, so the letters are arranged over again

explanation.surface: An artist's model is told to take a break and then pose once more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'afresh' rearranges the letters of REST IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who poses for a portrait or photograph is a model sitting for the artist.

clue.text: Common sailor boy in train crash

indicators.note: in places the boy inside the wreckage
a train crash wrecks the letters of train into a new order

parts.note: Paul is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A deckhand's son is caught in a railway accident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crash' scrambles the train into TARIN and 'in' sets the boy inside it. The answer is also tarred canvas, hence a sailor's nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an old word for an ordinary seaman, a tar, from the tarred canvas sailors wore.

clue.text: On way in, proceed to have a drink

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
taken as written
to go is to move forward

explanation.surface: Someone heading off says that once en route they will stop for a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: STINGO is an old name for strong ale.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an archaic term for a strong beer, so it is one kind of alcoholic beverage.

clue.text: Work by poet about particular period

annotationWithheld.why: Work by poet about particular period (7): the only parse found is ERA inside an anagram of POET (OP-ERA-TE), which needs 'about' as both anagram and container indicator, a word doing two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Work by poet about particular period

clue.text: Try a prison sentence

definitions.meaning: to strain or test, as in testing someone's patience
a term served in jail, in slang

explanation.definitionFit: Taxing someone's patience is one sense; a spell behind bars is British and American slang.

clue.text: Persian governor takes some when rising

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the letters read upward, backwards

parts.note: a part is some of something
as means when

explanation.surface: A provincial ruler grabs a share as he climbs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns PART + AS into SATRAP; 'takes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This was the title of a provincial governor in the ancient Persian empire.

clue.text: Greek girl in man's embrace

indicators.note: in shows the girl placed within the man

parts.note: he is a man's pronoun
Ellen is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A Greek woman held in a man's arms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' sets the girl within the man's pronoun, which splits around her; 'embrace' completes the picture of him holding her.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hellene is the Greeks' own name for a person from Greece.

clue.text: Shoot king in jet

indicators.note: in places the king within the jet

parts.note: a spout is a jet of liquid
R is the abbreviation for rex, king

explanation.surface: A monarch is fired from a jet.
explanation.definitionFit: A new growth from a plant is both a shoot and a sprout, noun synonyms.

clue.text: Paper written by dry people on time

parts.note: to parch is to dry out
men as people in general

explanation.surface: A document written by thirsty folk at a set hour.
explanation.definitionFit: Treated animal skin was the writing material of old manuscripts, an early kind of writing sheet.

clue.text: Tyrant finding love in the crowd

indicators.note: in places love within the crowd

parts.note: the herd is the common crowd
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A despot discovers affection among the masses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts O inside HERD; 'finding' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical king of Judea who ordered the massacre of the innocents epitomises a cruel despot.

clue.text: Treasure discovered in a glen

indicators.note: read as 'dis-covered', the letters are uncovered and reshuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone stumbles on a hoard in a Scottish valley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discovered' rearranges A GLEN; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone a darling or a gem uses this term of endearment, much like calling them precious.

clue.text: Old film star found at top of house

definitions.meaning: Clark ..., Hollywood star of Gone with the Wind
the triangular end wall under a pitched roof

explanation.definitionFit: Clark Gable starred in classic films; a pointed end wall forms the upper part of a building.

clue.text: Tree hides one in sore distress

indicators.note: the word in shows one piece placed within another
sore in distress is upset and so its letters are scrambled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A tree conceals someone who is suffering painfully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distress' rearranges SORE to OSER, and 'in' puts I inside it; 'hides' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A willow whose pliant twigs are used in basketry, so it is a type of tree.

clue.text: Girl unusually liable to be had

parts.note: Ava is a girl's name

indicators.note: acting unusually means behaving out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A young woman is uncharacteristically likely to be won over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusually' scrambles the second word into ILABLE; the surface's 'to be had' hints at seduction, but it means obtainable.
explanation.definitionFit: Something obtainable or free for use can be had, as in a seat being free.

clue.text: Machine operator can't read lengthy instruction excerpt

indicators.note: an excerpt is an extract, so the letters lie within the words

explanation.surface: A manual's sentence is too long for anyone to follow.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is lifted from canT READ LEngthy; 'instruction' completes the picture of a manual.
explanation.definitionFit: A foot pedal drives machines such as old sewing machines or lathes, operating the mechanism.

clue.text: Stick to telling people which room one is in?

definitions.meaning: to be inherent in, fixed in or belonging to something

definitions.text: telling people which room one is in?
definitions.meaning: what one calls out to show one's whereabouts in a house

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to exist within as an essential quality, which matches clinging to something; the second part is the phrase split in two.
